strongest_angle: Boston Public Schools and city officials announced an AI-enabled stop-arm camera safety program in October 2026 to catch and penalize drivers who illegally pass school buses, starting with a three-month warning period.

key_facts.fact: The City of Boston and Boston Public Schools announced a plan in October 2026 to install stop-arm cameras on school buses to identify and fine drivers who illegally pass them.
Boston Mayor Michelle Wu addressed the new stop-arm camera safety legislation and program during the October 2026 announcement.
The Boston Public Schools Transportation Department, located at 2300 Washington Street in Roxbury, MA 02119, requested vendor proposals for the AI-enabled stop-arm camera safety program.
The school bus safety camera program in Boston includes a three-month pilot period that will issue warnings before officially expanding to fines.
